description: She wears an opaque burgundy floor-length gown with a low square neckline, fitted structured bodice, elbow-length sleeves, broad antique-gold geometric woven trim at the neckline, waist, cuffs and hem, two round shoulder brooches, a cream-and-gold patterned wrap resting along the arms, and gold-brown closed shoes. No headgear, armor or weapon is visible.
